issue.detail: Spec does not define prev_in history across reset; contract updates prev_in during reset so a 1 under reset then 0 after release captures. Alternative clearing/suppressing prev_in during reset would not capture.
issue.spec_evidence: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
issue.alternative: Clear or suppress prev_in while reset is high, so reset=1/in=1 followed by reset=0/in=0 leaves out=0.
